0022600165.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, 6-0 and first in the Southwest and the West, host the New Orleans Pelicans in their seventh game of the season, with New Orleans at 2-4, 11th in the West, and 4 games back in fifth place in the Southwest. Memphis is missing Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while New Orleans is without Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), both out, and Dejounte Murray is day-to-day for personal reasons and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the last meeting came on January 30 in New Orleans, when the Grizzlies lost 114-106.
